fields.name: ReminderOptionsDefaults reminder-period bounds
fields.description: The three reminder-period bounds ArgentSea's reminder storage declares as supported defaults. ArgentSeaReminderOptionsValidator.ValidateConfiguration reads only MinimumReminderPeriodMinutes, as the floor below which a configured ReminderOptions.MinimumReminderPeriod is admitted with a warning instead of rejected. RefreshReminderListPeriodMinutes and InitializationTimeoutMinutes are declared alongside it but are not read anywhere in ValidateConfiguration.

members.name: MinimumReminderPeriodMinutes
members.description: Floor, in minutes, below which a configured ReminderOptions.MinimumReminderPeriod is admitted with a logged warning rather than accepted silently or rejected. Literal value: 1.

members.name: RefreshReminderListPeriodMinutes
members.description: Default interval, in minutes, associated with ReminderOptions.RefreshReminderListPeriod. Literal value: 5. Not read by ValidateConfiguration.
members.notes: Declared but unused by the validator's current checks.

members.name: InitializationTimeoutMinutes
members.description: Default maximum time, in minutes, associated with ReminderOptions.InitializationTimeout. Literal value: 5. Not read by ValidateConfiguration.
members.notes: Declared but unused by the validator's current checks.
